Leah: Final lock for webinar run-of-show — short replies only. Need: keynote length, demo owner, rehearsal times, and who owns failover toggle.

Ava: I'll own slides + a compact benchmark graphic. Need numbers from Priya by EOD Thu.

Priya: Sending numbers + a fixed 50-token demo prompt. Recommend 15/25/20 split to maximize demo.

Ravi: I'll own demo failover toggle and a 1-line scrub script. Plan: Dedicated -> Hosted-quant -> EU warm cache. Will push a small toggle we can flip in greenroom.

Ethan: I'll moderate and map demo requests to SDR queues. Suggest a 2-min poll after keynote (PoC/Scale/Security) for routing.

Ops: Zoom->SFDC mapping ready for campaign "webinar-spring". We will tag interest_level and demo_click. Recording retention 90 days.

Leah: Run-of-show (60m):
```
0:00 - 0:02  Welcome + housekeeping (Leah)
0:02 - 0:17  Keynote (Sarah)
0:17 - 0:42  Live demo (Miguel + Ravi)
0:42 - 0:56  Panel (Oliver, Sarah, Miguel)
0:56 - 1:00  Close + CTA (Leah + Ethan)
```
Rehearsals: tech check 30m (48h prior), full dress 60m (24h prior), final mic check 15m (15m prior).

Leah: Actions: Ava design (Mon EOD), Priya prompt (Fri), Ravi toggle + scrub (Wed), Ops mapping (Tue), speakers upload slides + consent (Wed noon). Reply with ack.
